title: Too Good to Be True – Individual and Collective Decision-Making with Misleading Signals
authors: Sebastian Fehrler; Anna Hochleitner; Moritz Janas
eligible_reason: Online/lab experiment on individual and group decisions with misleading (correlated) signals; randomized between-subject treatments analyzed with logit and OLS on treatment dummies. No panel DiD design.
design_notes: 2_TGTBT_tablesandfigures.do: logit DecisionBlue on expected payoff / majority signal; reg VoteWrong_exante CorrelatedSignals (##OneThreeBlueBalls##CommunicationTreatment), cluster(ID/GroupID).
data_files_note: Experimental data shipped (raw and cleaned) with Lioness programming files.
